metadata.short_desc: Query rankings on your own Hydro (HydroOJ) server, with multi-site support and image output.
metadata.desc:
Bring the ranking board of your own **Hydro (HydroOJ)** server into AstrBot.

- Show the top N users or any page; columns adapt to each site (rank / username / RP / problems / contests / check-ins / contribution / accepted / bio)
- Configure several Hydro sites and switch between them with an alias
- Supports Hydro domains: requests `/d/<domain>/ranking` automatically
- Look up a user's rank by username or UID across pages, with the matched row highlighted
- Renders a table image by default, and falls back to plain text when no CJK font is available
- Built-in cache to avoid hammering the target server

Command: `/hydro_rank` (alias `/排名`). Send `/hydro_rank help` for full usage.

base_url.hint: Root URL of your Hydro site, e.g. https://hydro.ac. You may also paste a full URL such as https://oj.example.com/d/system/ranking.

domain.hint: When set, requests go to /d/<domain>/ranking. Leave empty to query the main domain. Hydro's default domain ID is system.

default_server_alias.hint: Used to tell sites apart when several are configured; applied when no alias is given in the command.

token.hint: Optional. Sent as Authorization: Bearer <token> for sites whose ranking is only visible to logged-in users.

extra_servers.hint: One per line, format: alias|site-url|domain-id|token (the last three are optional). Lines starting with # are ignored.

rows_per_page.hint: How many rows to show when the command has no count. Hydro returns at most 100 rows per page.

enable_image.hint: Turn off to send plain text instead, for platforms without image support or environments where Pillow cannot be installed.

show_bio.hint: Bios can be long, so enabling this makes the image wider.

max_scan_pages.hint: How many pages to scan when looking up a user, 100 users per page. Smaller is faster, larger covers more users.

admin_only_find.hint: When enabled, the find / user subcommands are restricted to AstrBot administrators.

timeout.hint: Timeout for a single HTTP request.

cache_ttl.hint: The same page will not be re-requested within this window. Set to 0 to disable caching.

font_path.hint: If Chinese characters render as boxes, point this to a CJK font file, e.g. C:\Windows\Fonts\msyh.ttc. Leave empty to auto-detect common fonts.

proxy.hint: Optional, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:7890. Leave empty to use proxy settings from environment variables.

user_agent.hint: Optional. Some sites validate the UA; leave empty to use the built-in browser UA.
